title: GeoCache: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View Texture Diffusion via Geometric Delta Transport
abstract: arXiv:2608.13255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geometry-conditioned multi-view diffusion enables high-quality 3D texture generation, but its repeated per-view denoiser evaluations introduce substantial computational cost. Existing training-free accelerators primarily exploit temporal redundancy by reusing computation across denoising steps. In multi-view texturing, however, skipping a step also removes the cross-view interaction that continually aligns different observations of the same surface, leading to rapidly degraded consistency and fidelity. Our analysis identifies a complementary source of redundancy: although intermediate features remain view-specific, geometrically corresponding surface points exhibit transferable evolution in their predicted clean signals. Based on this observation, we introduce \gc{}, a training-free plugin that evaluates a rotating subset of anchor views and transports their geometry-aligned per-step $\xz$ updates to the remaining views. translated_title: GeoCache：通过几何增量传输实现多视图纹理扩散的无训练加速
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13255v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：几何条件化的多视图扩散能够实现高质量的3D纹理生成，但其重复的逐视图去噪器评估带来了显著的计算成本。现有的无训练加速器主要通过跨去噪步骤重用计算来利用时间冗余。然而，在多视图纹理化中，跳过一个步骤也会移除跨视图交互，这种交互持续对齐同一表面的不同观察结果，导致一致性和保真度迅速下降。我们的分析识别出一种互补的冗余来源：尽管中间特征保持视图特定性，但几何对应的表面点在其预测的干净信号中表现出可迁移的演化。基于这一观察，我们引入了\gc{}，一种无训练插件，它评估旋转的锚定视图子集，并将其几何对齐的逐步$\xz$更新传输到剩余视图。定期全量更新确保长期一致性。
tldr: 本论文提出一种无训练加速方法GeoCache，通过识别几何对应表面点在预测信号中的可迁移演化，仅评估部分锚定视图并传输其更新，从而在不牺牲多视图一致性的前提下显著降低纹理扩散的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GeoCache, a training-free acceleration method that exploits the transferable evolution of geometrically corresponding surface points by evaluating only a rotating subset of anchor views and transporting their updates, significantly reducing computational cost without sacrificing multi-view consistency.
